package.name: Agent Link
package.description: Drive FreeCAD from an AI agent over the Model Context Protocol: hundreds of tools to make, measure, check, draw, simulate (CalculiX), mill and export parts, buildings (BIM, IFC) and assemblies, headless or live in your window, with a panel for notes, steps, review and activity. Add-ons installed beside it bring more tools. Works with Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code, LM Studio and other MCP clients. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the FreeCAD project or the FPA.

workbench.name: Agent Link
workbench.description: Start and stop the agent's link to this window, the Agent Link panel, a screenshot for the agent, the setup check and updates.

preferencepack.name: Studio Light
preferencepack.description: A flat, quiet light theme: FreeCAD's own stylesheet with one surface per role, hairline borders and a single blue accent. Its colours are theme parameters, editable and exportable.

preferencepack.name: Studio Dark
preferencepack.description: The dark counterpart of Studio Light: the same roles and accent on dark surfaces.
